definitions.explanation: A sequence of musical notes that form a recognizable tune.

examples.japanese: {美|うつく}しい{旋律|せんりつ}だ。
{旋律|せんりつ}を{口|くち}ずさむ。
この{旋律|せんりつ}が{頭|あたま}から{離|はな}れない。
examples.english: I can't get this melody out of my head.

notes:
{旋律|せんりつ} is the formal/technical Japanese word for melody, used especially in classical music and formal writing.

CONTRAST:
- {旋律|せんりつ}: formal/technical (classical music, analysis)
- メロディー: casual/general use

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {美|うつく}しい{旋律|せんりつ}: beautiful melody
- {旋律|せんりつ}を{奏|かな}でる: to play a melody
- {旋律|せんりつ}が{流|なが}れる: melody flows
- {旋律|せんりつ}を{口|くち}ずさむ: to hum a melody

RELATED MUSIC TERMS:
- {和音|わおん}: chord
- {拍子|ひょうし}: rhythm, time signature
- {調|ちょう}: key (musical)
